Title: Regarding DawnOps + Drawing Out the Beast/Catatonic Fear etc.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, "Eric J. Liu" <el...@EMAIL.CSUN.EDU> wrote:
> Had a question about the interaction between Dawn Operation and Drawing
> Out the Beast (also Catatonic Fear) - I'm sure the issue has been brought
> up before, however, I wasn't able to quickly locate a definitive answer...
>
> Assuming that Dawn Operation was played correctly and combat has ensued
> between two vampires, if one of them were to play superior Drawing Out
> the Beast to cause one unpreventable damage at the end of each round to
> her opponent (or played Catatonic Fear at superior to cause combat to end
> and delivered a point of damage to her opponent) would that damage be
> aggravated from Dawn Operation's effect?

DotB deals damage at the end of the round, which is during combat.
So the damage would be aggravated if a Dawn Op was in effect.

Catatonic Fear ends combat and the damage it deals is applied after
the combat has ended (since S:CE precludes the possibility of doing
damage during strike resolution). So the damage is not affected by
Dawn Operation.
